podcast.body: An instrumental track from the 1981 album *Moving Pictures*. This piece is notable for its complex time signature of 10/8, making it challenging for dancing. The song's title, YYZ, is the IATA airport code for Toronto Pearson International Airport, and this code is ingeniously woven into the music using Morse code. "The track is hard to dance due because it's in the time signature of 10-8."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This instrumental track by Rush is noted for its incorporation of the "devil's tri tone" (flattened fifth), showcasing the band's musical complexity and embrace of diverse harmonic structures. "In addition to a ton of Sabbath and Hendrix songs, they can also be heard in David Bowie's station to station, the beautiful people by Marilyn Manson, Blurred Girls and Boys, SIGDIS X1 and YYZ by Rush, Enter Sandman from Metallica."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
